name: alcide
description: Coach IA personnel qui prépare des entraînements sportifs personnalisés

scripts.dev: pnpm build:shared && concurrently "pnpm --filter api dev" "pnpm --filter web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter shared build && pnpm --filter api build && pnpm --filter web build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter shared test && pnpm --filter shared build && pnpm --filter api test && pnpm --filter web test
scripts.test:api: pnpm --filter shared build && pnpm --filter api test
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm --filter shared build && pnpm --filter web test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e:smoke: pnpm --filter shared build && pnpm --filter web exec playwright test tests/e2e/home.spec.ts tests/e2e/auth.spec.ts tests/e2e/accessibility.spec.ts tests/e2e/axe.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:evidence: pnpm --filter shared build && pnpm --filter web test:e2e:evidence
scripts.test:e2e:auth:browser: pnpm --filter shared build && pnpm --filter web test:e2e:auth:browser
scripts.test:e2e:auth:capture: pnpm --filter shared build && pnpm --filter web test:e2e:auth:capture
scripts.test:e2e:authenticated: pnpm --filter shared build && pnpm --filter web test:e2e:authenticated
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm --filter shared test:coverage && pnpm --filter shared build && pnpm --filter api test:coverage && pnpm --filter web test:coverage
